items.html: And it goes out from the Concealed Brain, from the radiance within it, namely from the light and the bone within it, and it is the upper Hesed. For the light and the bone in Keter, Hochma and Bina spread in the three upper heads, and in the forehead and the beard; and the light of the bone of Hesed went out, and it is the upper Hesed, and it is called, in its going out from there, the pure air. And it is hidden within the spirit that is hidden in Atik Yomin, and it is in the form of a body and vessel to this pure air. And this is what we say in the Idra Zuta, page 292, column 2, and this is its language: 'And that Aba is a spirit hidden in Atik Yomin, and in it this air is hidden, and it absorbs the spark that goes out from the lamp, etc.' — end of his language. And further we learned in the Idra Rabba, page 131, column 2, and this is its language: 'And this air is the most hidden of the hidden of Atik Yomin, a spirit hidden in this skull, etc.' — end of his language.
